messages.subject: Re: Leaflet event
parts:
Hi,

In my ui.R I have:

leafletOutput("map", height = 250)

In server.R I have

output$map <- renderLeaflet({
   
    lmap <- leaflet()
   
    lmap <- lmap %>%
      addTiles('http://{s}.tiles.mapbox.com/v3/jcheng.map-5ebohr46/{z}/{x}/{y}.png')       
   
    lmap <- lmap %>% setView(20, 25, zoom = 2)
   
    addMarkers(lmap, 2.0833, 41.2974, layerId = "bcn")
   
  })

In leaflet-shiny you would capture a click on the marker by:

observe({
    evt <<- input$map_marker_click
  })

This does not seem to have any effect with the new version of leaflet. What would be the right syntax?

Thanks!
